Booleans, floats, strings, and `None` are invalid.\n6\t- If the amount is not a positive integer, or it exceeds the available balance, `withdraw` returns `False` and the balance stays the same.\n7\t- Otherwise, `withdraw` deducts the amount from the balance and returns `True`.\n8\t\n9\tAdapted from IS212 Week 6.\n10\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"685c6400-e5b4-4a29-8a02-0c62a3e83dd3","uuid":"b522220f-9564-4ba4-909d-bcb30e31b545","timestamp":"2026-10-20T09:16:28.210Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\Aaron\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\ewallet-task-o6ln91cu\\workspace\\SPEC.md","content":"# EWallet: withdraw\n\n`EWallet.withdraw(amount)` takes money out of the wallet.\n\n- `amount` must be an integer (`int`).
